scope: Inventory distinguishes decoded assets, original-instruction fixtures, browser transport and controlled live gameplay dispatch. It does not claim every random branch was reached during a complete race or auditory equality with an original sound-card recording.

coverage.category: Menu navigation, selection, options, country information and debrief voices
coverage.limits: Five referenced menu WAV names are absent from both supplied sources; menu-sources.json retains them without substitutes.

coverage.category: Movies and six looping race music streams
coverage.limits: Music follows original DirectShow gain conversion; movie sound uses its original full source level. Browser codec output is not an original sound-card recording.

coverage.category: Player starter, engine layers and gear effect
coverage.limits: Original car0 settings are used for all karts. Cylinder scheduler418ad0 is gated off by the empty shipped Cylinders sample list.
SFXVOLUME gates the handler; controller enable gates a new start. Existing loop pitch/stop order is preserved.
311 independent attached sources; hidden callbacks preserve already playing audio, path stop explicitly stops it. Previous listener snapshot is used.
174 independent PION_HIT_CAR clones, one nonloop spatial update at launch. No shared global impact source.

coverage.category: Pickup and five weapon firing effects
coverage.limits: Player-only EFFECTS queue. Static random type7 requests absent GOT_BONUS; collectible type6 requests absent GOT_EURO. These are preserved original missing names.

coverage.category: Hits, passing, catchup, boost, pickup and attacker/victim character speech
coverage.limits: Native selector/chance RNG and request ordering are tested separately against original instructions; 327 logical bank entries reach actual sources. Not every random speech branch is reached by a complete driven race.

coverage.category: Lap and record announcements, countdown and time gates
coverage.limits: COMM announcements use effects FIFO10; STARTSE1..4,TIME_TICK,CHECKPOINT are direct effects with native repeat suppression.
840 original selector cases and192 contact-latch cases verify shared RNG and duplicate callbacks. Seven direct effect sources preload before contact.
DISAPP/REAPP go to recovered racer logical voice FIFO at pre-update frame3, with no chance or RNG draw.
Actual target-player arm ratio, strict float32 .1 timer and .4/.7 thresholds;1200 instruction cases includeNaN/Infinity. Queues after current voice service.
Native available-character-index to racer-index mismatch, missing CLAXON replacement and directKT4 preserved, outside debug guard.
